download_bound.scope: per attempt; prior attempts remain retained and the global free-space floor is checked throughout each download

fit_feasibility: requires root interpretation of actual profile logs/resources
profile_success_note: Collection completeness is independent of scientific/profile success; provider terminal status and per-job outcomes require separate interpretation.
provider_file_inventory_semantics: Actual list_kernel_session_output descriptors used by kernels output; each exposes file_name and URL only. URLs are never persisted. The provider returns no size/checksum, so local byte sizes and SHA-256 are recorded without claiming remote-byte hash verification.
provider_listing_version_scope: The installed Kaggle kernels_output implementation requests list_kernel_session_output with user_name and kernel_slug and leaves version_label unset. This is current-slug output, not API-version-pinned. Bind this unique slug to root push version 1 and the actual returned runtime spec/source hashes; do not claim endpoint version pinning.
